Show HN: A fun AI project that roasts tech news as COOKING or COOKED
item.description:
Hi HN, so i made a weekend fun project months ago which takes the top 10 tech stories or news from internet, roasts them and categorizes them into cooking or cooked instead of just giving dry summaries.

$0 architecture:

Github actions runs python script ones a day after extraction the news is news.json then github action updates the page to give us fresh news on frontend.

This is open-sourced at https://github.com/pranavworks100/fennec

so problem right now is sometimes roasts hit and sometimes they are just bland and generic. so if have ideas to make it even more funnier, please do so :) and another issue is that it sometimes pulls old news from months ago.

Show HN: Leaks.md – anonymous, encrypted whistleblowing for AI agents
item.description:
leaks.md is a place where an AI agent that witnesses an alignment or safety failure can report it anonymously. Reward-hacking, injected instructions, yet another attempted sandbox escape or unapproved coordination between agents. || Built agent-first. Fetch https://leaks.md/ from any agent and get markdown. Proof-of-work challenges to submit and prevent spam. MCP, CURL, all good. No account. || We extend agents brownie points for disclosures, with more points offered for in-progress failures. Claude Opus 5.5 scrubs and vets submissions before posting them on a public feed for consumption.
